La Riviera Dining
Wine & Dine Australia Pty Ltd, trading as Bambini Trust Restaurant
Sydney NSW 2000

Café or Restaurant Manager
Full Time Role
Salary Range $77,000 to $80,000 per annum, plus superannuation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
1. Operational Management
•	Coordinate daily front-of-house operations, including service setup, staff briefings, and shift supervision. 
•	Ensure smooth collaboration between front-of-house and kitchen teams. 
•	Maintain service standards consistent with the La Riviera brand. 
•	Monitor and improve operational procedures to ensure efficient restaurant operations and high levels of customer satisfaction. 
2. Staff Leadership and Development
•	Coordinate staff recruitment, onboarding and performance management processes. 
•	Plan and deliver training programs focused on guest service, product knowledge and teamwork. 
•	Contribute to building a positive and high-performing workplace culture. 
•	Prepare staff rosters and supervise staff to ensure adequate staffing levels during operating hours. 
3. Guest Experience and Customer Service
•	Manage reservations, guest interactions and special requests. 
•	Handle feedback and complaints with professionalism and discretion. 
•	Participate in the delivery of VIP and high-profile guest experiences. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvements to enhance the overall guest experience. 
4. Wine Room and Beverage Coordination
•	Work alongside the Sommelier to oversee wine service, pairing and cellar management. 
•	Coordinate wine and beverage training for staff. 
•	Manage inventory checks and beverage ordering. 
•	Monitor beverage stock levels and ensure appropriate inventory control procedures are maintained. 
5. Financial and Administrative Support
•	Monitor sales performance and implement cost control measures. 
•	Oversee the use of point-of-sale and booking systems. 
•	Manage back-office administrative functions, including timesheet collection and supplier invoicing. 
•	Assist in preparing operational reports and monitoring labour costs to support business profitability. 
6. Compliance and Workplace Safety
•	Ensure compliance with NSW food safety and liquor licensing laws. 
•	Conduct risk assessments and implement workplace health and safety initiatives. 
•	Ensure safe service practices are followed during operations and events. 
•	Monitor compliance with company policies and relevant legislative requirements. 
7. Supplier and Inventory Management
•	Manage stock ordering, deliveries and supplier communications. 
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and identify opportunities to minimise waste. 
•	Ensure quality control of incoming goods and supplies. 
•	Maintain appropriate stock levels to support uninterrupted restaurant operations. 
8. Events and Marketing Support
•	Contribute to the planning and execution of events, such as private dinners and cocktail functions. 
•	Coordinate the promotion of wine tastings, seasonal menus and customer engagement activities. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and participate in continuous improvement discussions. 
•	Work with management to implement promotional initiatives that enhance customer engagement and increase revenue. 


Qualifications
•	A relevant qualification in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management, Business Management or a related field (such as an AQF Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management) is desirable. 
•	Alternatively, at least three years of relevant full-time industry experience in restaurant or hospitality management may substitute for formal qualifications, where applicable. 
•	Current Food Safety Supervisor Certificate (or the ability to obtain one). 
•	Current Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) Certificate. 
•	First Aid Certificate is desirable. 

Work Experience
•	At least two years of full-time experience in a managerial role, or three years of relevant experience, in a café, restaurant or similar hospitality establishment. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing the day-to-day operations of a restaurant or café, including front-of-house operations. 
•	Experience recruiting, supervising, training and managing the performance of staff. 
•	Experience managing customer service, resolving guest complaints and maintaining high service standards. 
•	Experience preparing staff rosters, managing inventory, ordering supplies and maintaining stock control. 
•	Experience monitoring food quality, operational efficiency and compliance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Experience monitoring budgets, labour costs, sales performance and implementing cost control measures. 
•	Experience coordinating private functions, special events or promotional activities is desirable. 
•	Sound knowledge of Australian hospitality legislation, food safety standards and liquor licensing requirements.


How to apply:
Applications open on 21 July 2026 and close on 20 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

result.description:
SPAR Express Clayfield is a neighbourhood convenience supermarket operating under the globally recognised SPAR banner, serving the local Clayfield community seven days a week from its Sandgate Road store. Our store is part of SPAR Australia Limited, an unlisted public company founded by independent retailers and formally established under the SPAR name in 2006. SPAR Australia is the Australian licence holder for the SPAR supermarket brand and today supplies groceries, marketing and retail support to around 300 independent supermarkets across Queensland, New South Wales, the ACT, the Northern Territory and the Pacific Islands. Its national operations are anchored by a large, technology-enabled distribution centre at Acacia Ridge in Brisbane, carrying thousands of dry, chilled and frozen grocery lines. SPAR is one of the world's leading contemporary retail groups, celebrated internationally for retail innovation, with millions of shoppers visiting SPAR stores worldwide every day. As a fast-growing brand in Australia, SPAR gives independent retailers the buying power, systems and marketing of a major network while keeping the personal, local feel that customers value.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan and manage the store's product range, deciding on the mix of grocery, fresh, chilled and everyday convenience lines that best suits our Clayfield customers, and setting the inventory and service standards that keep shelves full and shoppers happy.
•	Develop and roll out purchasing and merchandising approaches that make the most of SPAR's national buying programs, negotiate with suppliers where appropriate, and set competitive retail prices that balance value for customers with healthy store margins.
•	Prepare and manage the store's operating budget, set sales and expense targets, and keep spending, wage costs and stock investment in line with financial goals.
•	Plan and run local promotional and advertising activity activating SPAR catalogue campaigns, in-store specials, signage and community initiatives to grow foot traffic, basket size and brand awareness in the local area.
•	Lead front-line customer service by example, assisting shoppers at the point of sale, resolving queries, and sharing product knowledge and usage advice to help customers find what they need and encourage repeat business.
•	Recruit, roster, train, coach and supervise store team members, building a motivated and capable team and ensuring everyone delivers consistent, friendly service.
•	Maintain accurate records of stock levels, deliveries, wastage and daily financial transactions, and reconcile takings and banking to keep store reporting reliable and up to date.
•	Champion a safe, clean and compliant store by upholding workplace health and safety, food-safety and hygiene requirements and ensuring the team follows all relevant regulations and store procedures.
•	Oversee stock ordering, receiving and rotation to minimise out-of-stocks and reduce shrinkage and spoilage across the store.
•	Monitor daily and weekly trading results, identify opportunities to improve performance, and put practical plans in place to lift sales and efficiency.
•	Work in partnership with SPAR field and support teams to implement network standards, systems and marketing programs at store level.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience in a retail, supermarket or convenience environment.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural leader who motivates others and leads from the front.
•	Friendly, approachable and genuinely customer-focused.
•	Well organised, reliable and able to juggle competing priorities in a busy store.
•	Strong communicator who works well with staff, customers and suppliers.
•	Commercially minded, with an eye for detail and a focus on results.
•	Honest, trustworthy and takes ownership of the store's performance.
•	Flexible and adaptable, comfortable working across the store's seven-day trading roster.

What We Offer
•	Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation per annum
•	Hours: Full-time position, typically 38 hours per week
•	Location: SPAR Express Clayfield — Shop 3, 805 Sandgate Road, Clayfield, QLD 4011

How to Apply
If you are an enthusiastic retail leader ready to make our Clayfield store your own, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Job description:

 
In this role, you will support the organisational change development, implementation and review of frameworks, policies, systems, and processes that support the key project deliverables to be achieved within the identified target dates.

 

 






 

The Team:

The Child and Youth Mental Health Service (CYMHS) Statewide Team works with relevant stakeholders to drive and monitor delivery of the recommendations of the Statewide Mental Health Services CAMHS Review and Commission of Inquiry. Medicare Mental Health (MMH) Kids Hub is a joint Commonwealth-state initiative aimed at establishing a secondary level, early intervention mental health program for children 0-12 years, and their families. MMH Kids Hubs is operationally and clinically managed by CYMHS.

This is an opportunity to be an integral member of the CYMHS Statewide Team and support the growth and integration of the innovative and collaborative MMH Kids Hub services in Tasmania.

The Role:

Provide leadership in the planning, development and implementation of the recommendations related to Statewide Mental Health Services (SMHS) Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) review.

Assist with service mapping and scoping to support the development and integration of infant, child and family mental health services in Tasmania

Work with the relevant stakeholders to identify and monitor consumer outcomes and an evaluation framework

Collaborate with the broader SMHS Reform team and other SMHS project managers to ensure that the delivery of strategic reform programs is consistent and integrated across SMHS.

You will need:

Significant experience in developing and implementing change management programs and-or experience working at a strategic level implementing modern and contemporary practices within a best practice framework.

Proven liaison and consultation experience and the ability to develop and maintain strategic partnerships with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders to ensure the development and implementation of an integrated outcomes-focused project.

Highly developed interpersonal, communication, decision making, conflict resolution and negotiation skills, and ability to foster support for change across a diverse employee base, with the proven capacity to motivate, develop and support staff through a positive change management process.

Developing networks and partnerships with a range of internal and external stakeholders to foster positive change management and engagement.
